children.why: The same symbols persist through residuals and gradients.
The one-dimensional slice makes a parameter setting and its score a single point on a curve.
Every row visibly contributes to MSE.
A tangent can be introduced without requiring 3D perception.
The gradient is uphill; the minus sign is the actual descent decision.
The final gradient is an average, not an unexplained oracle.
Eta changes distance while preserving the chosen direction.
Recomputing predictions and MSE closes the learning loop.
Both parameters move from the same gradient snapshot.
The visible result verifies what the update actually changed.
